name: editable
title: Editable
description: A value read as text that becomes a field in place.
use: A value read far more often than it is changed, changed one at a time where it stands: a title, a name, a cell. It takes the type of what holds it, so it may be a heading. The page saves the value; the stylesheet draws pending with aria-busy="true".

instead.when: Several values are changed together and saved at once
The value is always being edited

keyboard.action: On the preview, open the field with the value selected
In the field, save and return to the preview; in a textarea, Control or Command with Enter
Put the saved value back and return to the preview
Leave the field, which saves the value, or puts it back when the field's constraints refuse it

platform.fallback: The field keeps the preview's width and its text scrolls past it

classes.name: editable
classes.description: The value and its field, in one cell that the preview holds open; it reaches out by its padding so the text lines up with the column

classes.name: editable-preview
classes.description: The saved value, as a button: plain text at rest, a faint well with a pencil under the pointer. Hidden, it still holds the cell open

classes.name: editable-field
classes.description: The field that takes the preview's place, hidden at rest: a focused well in the same font, padding and corner

classes.name: editable-placeholder
classes.description: Inside the preview, what it says while the value is empty: the field's placeholder, in the muted ink

states.name: pending
states.description: The value is on its way: the preview reads muted and takes no press

states.name: editing
states.description: Hidden at rest; the behavior shows it and hides the preview

states.name: invalid
states.description: Or :user-invalid: the field takes the danger edge

states.name: disabled
states.description: The value cannot be changed: no well, no pencil

properties.name: --editable-padding-x
properties.description: Inline padding of the preview and the field, which the root bleeds into

properties.name: --editable-padding-y
properties.description: Block padding of the preview and the field
